title: Top-Level Prefix Characterization
statement: Let $w,R\in\mathbb{N}$, let $E$ be a relation on finite Boolean words, let $I$ and $J$ be predicates on such words, and let $\sigma$ be an infinite Boolean assignment. The quantified formula with three consecutive blocks of $w$ existential quantifiers followed by $R$ levels of the prefix specified by the recursive pattern “existential block, universal block, universal block” is true from position $0$, with matrix requiring $I$ on the block read at positions $w$ through $2w-1$, $J$ on the block read at positions $2w$ through $3w-1$, and the recursively defined level matrix from position $3w$, if and only if there are Boolean words $A,B$ of length $w$ for which $I(A)$ and $J(B)$ hold and $\mathrm{Mid}_w(E,R,A,B)$ holds. Here $\mathrm{Mid}_w(E,0,A,B)$ means $E(A,B)$, and $\mathrm{Mid}_w(E,r+1,A,B)$ means that some word $z$ of length $w$ satisfies both $\mathrm{Mid}_w(E,r,A,z)$ and $\mathrm{Mid}_w(E,r,z,B)$.
hypotheses_covered: A relation $E$ on finite Boolean words
Predicates $I$ and $J$ on finite Boolean words
